name: highest-data-hub
description: Data bundle reseller platform - React + Node.js + MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
